    raw = BASE.read_bytes()

                'resumed': False,

"""
    text = text.replace(ASSIGNED, ASSIGNED + hook)
    module = types.ModuleType("root_owned_before_resume")

    exec(compile(text, str(BASE) + "::root-before-resume", "exec"), module.__dict__)
